column1: # Stroke orders entered by hand, for characters and components the sources do not record.
#   source  the table the order supplements and whose symbols it is written in:
#           cns11643 or kanjivg (1 横, 2 豎, 3 撇, 4 點, 5 折), or rime-stroke (h s p n z)
#   orders  one code per way of writing it, separated by a space
#   basis   where the order was read: a citation, or the reasoning behind an editorial reading
# `data/open-strokes/wanted.tsv` lists the components whose order would let the most characters be written.

column4: CNS 全字庫 writes 丿, the unified ideograph Unicode gives as the equivalent of ㇒, as 3
